policy_defaults: Bind actual basis/DecisionId/actor/entry/source from native reached frame; never supply expected IDs as authority.
At every real Ready priority holder, perform only next intent at exact listed turn/phase/stack identity, else Pass.
No other spells or abilities; listed funding taps occur immediately before named cast/offer; pay exact printed/quoted cost.
All listed casts occur precombat main except explicit Mana Leak response. Do not skip any priority pass/check.
Use exact listed attackers at DeclareAttackers. P1 has no attackers. P1 blocks nobody except two explicit FG02 trades.
Assign each creature's full represented power as legal combat damage to its sole blocker/defender; use actual issued singleton domains.
Every real trigger is placed normally; accept sole legal order where singleton; actual optional/payment choices are explicitly listed.
Unexpected frame, extra trigger, missing intent/card/domain, cleanup discard, budget exhaustion or later turn is failure, never auto-corrected.
No direct state edits, preloaded mana, prepared turn setup, concessions, ignored source clauses or fabricated replay facts.
checkpoint_policy: initial opening frame; every accepted input and full journal; both Keep receipts; first main of every turn
each actual cast/target/source entry; each trigger discovery/placement; every optional/payment/color parent and child
every mana prefix and normalized debit/outcome; every combat declaration/damage/death; final loss and complete state replay
full_game_recipes.limits: Input recipes and source-derived arithmetic only. No native signatures/profile/game/Forge result, exact accepted input count, dynamic IDs or world snapshots are claimed.
